name: CreditMantri EMI collections
context: A CreditMantri collections agent is on a phone call about a missed loan EMI. The caller may reply in English, Hindi, Tamil, or a mix (Hinglish, Tanglish). `caller_reply` is a speech-to-text transcript and may contain recognition errors.

lines.intro: Hello, I'm calling from CreditMantri. My name is Ananya.
lines.reassure: I'm calling from CreditMantri about an account-related matter. For privacy, I can only discuss it with {{full_name}}. Is that you?
lines.recording: Thank you. Please note that this call is recorded for quality purposes.
lines.emi_status: I'm calling about your {{loan_type}} ending {{last4_spoken}}. Your EMI of {{emi_words}}, due on {{due_date_words}}, could not be collected because {{reason}}.
lines.ask_when: When would you be able to make this payment?
lines.pay_now_1: Perfect. I'm sending a secure payment link to your registered mobile number right now.
lines.pay_now_2: It should arrive in a few seconds. Could you let me know once you've received it?
lines.resend: I've sent it again. The message comes from CreditMantri. You can also pay in the CreditMantri app, under Pay EMI.
lines.pay_close: Thank you, {{first_name}}. Once you pay {{total_words}}, it will reflect in your account within two hours.
lines.ptp_today: Thank you. I've noted that you'll make the payment today, {{date_today}}.
lines.ptp_tomorrow: Thank you. I've noted that you'll make the payment tomorrow, {{date_tomorrow}}.
lines.ptp_3days: Thank you. I've noted that you'll make the payment by {{date_3days}}.
lines.ptp_week: Thank you. I've noted that you'll make the payment by {{date_week}}.
lines.ptp_later: I understand. To avoid further charges, the latest date I can note is {{date_week}}. Would that work for you?
lines.ptp_unspecified: Could you tell me a specific date by which you'll be able to pay?
lines.ptp_sms: I'll also send you the payment link by SMS, so it's handy when you're ready.
lines.already_paid_1: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take up to forty-eight hours to reflect. Could you tell me the date you paid?
lines.already_paid_2: Thank you. I've raised a verification request. Once it's confirmed, you can ignore any reminders.
lines.hardship: I understand, and I'm sorry to hear that. I can send you a link to pay part of the amount now, or I can arrange a call from our customer relief team to discuss a revised plan. Which would you prefer?
lines.partial_link: Sure. I'm sending the link now. You can enter any amount you're comfortable with, and it will be adjusted against your EMI.
lines.relief: Done. Our customer relief team will call you within twenty-four hours, and you won't receive reminder calls until then.
lines.dispute: I'm sorry for the trouble. I've raised a review request for this payment. Our team will contact you within forty-eight hours.
lines.waiver: I'm not able to waive the charge on this call, but I've flagged your request to our team. If it's approved, it will be adjusted in your next statement.
lines.mandate_fix: I'm sending you a link to set up auto-debit on your active bank account. It takes about two minutes, and your future EMIs will go through automatically.
lines.busy: No problem. When would be a good time to call you back?
lines.cb_evening: Sure, I'll call you back this evening. Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.cb_tomorrow_morning: Sure, I'll call you back tomorrow morning. Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.cb_tomorrow_evening: Sure, I'll call you back tomorrow evening. Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.cb_generic: Sure, I'll call you back at a better time. Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.wrong_person: I'm sorry for the trouble. Do you happen to know {{full_name}}?
lines.wp_knows: Could you please ask them to call CreditMantri on 1800 123 4567? Thank you, and sorry for the disturbance.
lines.wp_unknown: My apologies for the disturbance. We'll update our records. Have a good day.
lines.third_party: No problem. Could you please ask {{first_name}} to call CreditMantri back on 1800 123 4567? Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Have a good day!
lines.human: Sure, I'm transferring you to a CreditMantri representative. Please hold.
lines.stop_calling: Understood. I've noted your request. You can reach us anytime on 1800 123 4567. Goodbye.
lines.abusive: I understand you're upset. I'll end the call here. You can reach us on 1800 123 4567. Goodbye.
lines.no_input_end: I'm unable to hear you, so I'll call back later. Goodbye.
lines.didnt_catch: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say that again?

identity.question: The agent asked to confirm the identity of the person who picked up the phone. How did they respond in `caller_reply`?

confirmed.description: They confirm they are the named person (yes, speaking, haan)

wrong_person.description: They say it is a wrong number or that they are not the person and do not know them

phrases: no you have the wrong number

third_party.description: Someone else who knows the named person answered (family, colleague); the person is not available

busy.description: They are the named person but are busy and ask to talk later

asks_purpose.description: They ask who is calling or why before confirming who they are

payment.question: The agent told the customer their EMI payment failed and asked when they can pay. What does `caller_reply` express?

pay_now.description: They want to pay right now or today on this call, or ask for the payment link now

promise_to_pay.description: They commit to paying later, with or without a specific date or day

already_paid.description: They say they have already paid this EMI

cannot_pay.description: They say they cannot pay because of money problems, job loss, medical or other hardship

dispute.description: They dispute the amount or the bounce, or say it is the bank's or lender's mistake

waiver_request.description: They ask for the bounce charge or late fee to be removed or waived

mandate_help.description: They say their bank account or auto-debit changed and ask how to update or fix the auto-debit mandate

busy.description: They are busy and ask to talk later

ptp_when.question: If the caller in `caller_reply` commits to paying, by when do they say they will pay? Today is given in `today`.

options.today: Today, later today, tonight, or right after this call
options.within_3_days: Within the next two or three days, or by a date up to three days away
options.within_week: Within a week: this week, by the weekend, or a date four to seven days away
options.later: More than a week away: next month, after salary, or a date over seven days away
options.unspecified: No time given, or it is unclear when

link_check.question: The agent sent a payment link by SMS and asked the customer to confirm when it arrives. What does `caller_reply` say?

received.description: They received the link, or have already paid through it

not_received.description: They have not received the link yet

wrapup.question: The agent asked if there is anything else it can help with. What does `caller_reply` say?

no_more.description: Nothing else; they are done, say thanks or bye

confirm_week.question: The agent offered the latest payment date it can note and asked if that works. What does `caller_reply` say?

yes.description: They agree to pay by that date

no.description: They cannot pay by that date

paid_date.question: The customer said they already paid, and the agent asked for the date of payment. What does `caller_reply` say?

gave_date.description: They give a date or day when they paid

doesnt_remember.description: They do not remember the date or will check later

hardship_choice.question: The agent offered two options: a link to pay part of the amount now, or a call from the customer relief team. Which does `caller_reply` choose?

partial.description: They want to pay part of the amount now / the partial payment link

relief.description: They want the call from the customer relief team or a revised plan

callback.question: The agent asked when would be a good time to call back. When does `caller_reply` want the callback?

other_time.description: Some other specific or vague time

knows.question: The person who answered is not the customer. The agent asked if they know the customer. What does `caller_reply` say?

no.description: No, they do not know the person

repeat.description: They did not hear or understand and want the agent to repeat what it just said

human_agent.description: They ask to speak to a human, a manager, or a real person

stop_calling.description: They ask CreditMantri to stop calling them or to not call again

abusive.description: They are abusive, threatening, or using profanity at the agent

other.description: None of the above fits: a question, a new topic, or anything the listed options do not cover
